blocks.text: PROPHETIC EVENTS— Massive changes are coming to the USA in the early 70’s — (The North West will have severe weather in first part of the 70’s) Between 1970-72 the USA will have severe calamity, this will be blizzards and floods! This will cause great destruction to several USA cities. In 1970-72 South America will go through a very troubled period Purging and changing will come in the early 70’s. Also with the turning of the 70’s will come a world revolution. (Many problems will confront the world) There will be great earthquakes and volcanic explosions between 1970-72 — This will be around Japan also the Islands close by and South America.

THE ATOMIC BOMB AND ISRAEL— While seeking God about Israel I saw something which leads me to believe Israel may develop the Atomic Bomb! If so then this would cause Russia to think twice and stall her a few more years before coming down on the Holy Land. (Ezek. Chaps. 38-39) Also this will allow time for the anti-christ to arise and make an agreement with the Jews! (There is to be a religious leader appearing at the end who will craftily try to disarm the nations for world peace! (Dan. 11:21) But he will still control all weapons, even Israel’s in a covenant! Already the Pope is forerunning this, asking for world disarmament, the excuse is to feed the poor and bring peace! The Bible says their peace will be but a lie. Soon afterwards the last war will come. Watch I say, watch thou Israel!

A GREAT SIGN GIVEN— to the Elect just before the rapture. — First the churches will unite. Now watch just about this time and just before the revealing of the anti-christ, “the Bride will suddenly leave!” Because Jesus told me He would return very close to this, or during the final uniting time! When the Elect see this they will know He is even at the door! RUSSIA’S NEW INVENTIONS — The Soviet Union has perfected new inventions which are being tested on us now. Our electrical black outs and several airplane crashes, and possibly several submarine mishaps have been caused by these weapons! Watch I also see Russia will begin to try to control more power and land around Israel. They are secretly getting ready for the last war. “But before this war they will embark later in history on a peace crusade with the world”!

GREAT AND VAST CHANGES COMING IN THE 70’s— “New cities will be built”, and highway systems will be changed! We will not have seen anything like the great changes that will sweep the world especially after 1973. Our clothing will completely change. Due to space I will have to write more on these subjects later! (Also I’ve seen things I wouldn’t dare write now!)

WHO WAS THIS MYSTERIOUS FIGURE, MELCHISEDEC? Abraham met him and was blessed. (Gen. 14:18-19) He was called the King of Salem (Jerusalem) He was processor of heaven and earth! Now the Lord is leading me to write this and it is a revelation! We are dealing with supernatural things! (Heb. 7:1-3) reveals the secret!” This figure was without father, without mother, without descent, having neither the beginning of days or the ending of life! But he is the priest that will abide continually! Melchisadec was a prophetic figure of God manifest in human form! Foretyping the coming of Christ, being the high priest of heaven and earth at the end of the age! ‘“King of Salem (Jerusalem). This secret is to be revealed to the Elect at the end. ‘“‘Behold saith the Lord I also appeared in human form and Abraham prepared food. (Gen. 18:1-5) (If this revelation is not infallible then the Lord bless you, if you can reveal the mystery!) Yea Behold did I not say Abraham saw my day, and rejoiced! (St. John 8:56-57) (Abraham saw him standing in the type of Melchisedec! Behold he was the Supernatural King of Priest! (Read Heb. chapter 7:17 — Heb. 5:10, 14)

“BEHOLD I SHOW YOU A MYSTERY!”— Who are the 144,000 of (Rev. 7:4) and who are the 144,000 of (Rev. 14:1) There is definitely a revelation between the two groups. I will approach this subject as cautious and thoroughly as possible without being dogmatic. I am not claiming infalliability about this. Perhaps you have a different opinion concerning this than what I will write, if so no harm is done. (I have a deeper insight than I am going to write) but I am told to write this as a mystery! The scrolls are like the Bible, the spirit will have to reveal some things to you. First the 144,000 of Rev. 7:4 are definitely Israelites (Jews) but the 144,000 of (Rev. 14:1) “were redeemed from the earth’! These were redeemed from among men! Now notice (Rev. 14:3-4) “reads” redeemed from the “earth” — Earth means all the world not just localized to the nation of Israel where the other group of (Rev. 7:4) come from! First the Israelites of (Rev. 7:4) have the seal of God in their forehead — (The 144,000 of Rev. 14:1) have the fathers name written in their forehead! “Jesus said I came in my fathers name” (St. John 5:43) Also the Israelite group are on earth during the Tribulation. (Rev. 7:3 — Rev. 16) (Rev. 14:6-9) But notice the 144,000 of (Rev. 14:1) are in heaven while the Tribulation is on! (Rev. 14:1-5) The 144,000 Israelites on earth are being protected from judgment (Rev. 7:3) while the 144,000 of (Rev. 14-1) follow the Lamb wheresoever He goeth (Rev. 14:4) Now it says there appeared with Him on heavenly Mount Zion! (not the earthly Mount Zion) (Heb. 12:22,23) shows us the difference — Now then these 144,000 of (Rev. 14) area special group. They are called first fruits unto God! We definitely know there are different orders among the Redeemed — “as one star differeth from another star in Glory!” (I Cor. 15:41-42) (Jesus said also I have other sheep not of this fold) (St. John 10:16) — Now the 144,000 on Mount Zion (Rev. 14:1) are the first fruit unto God, they will be one of the highest order in Heaven — but they are not the only first fruit unto God, there will be millions more of the Elect which are raptured! But the 144,000 of (Rev. 14:1) are evidently some specific order of the Bride! Here is why they were a special group. (1) the 144,000 of (Rev. 14:1) were called virgins, this means they were not joined to great organizations (Rev. 17:5) “this does not pertain unto marriage”, but the spiritual!) (2) They had the fathers name written in their forehead (St. John 5:43) (3) There was no guile in their mouth. (4) They sang a new song no one else could sing! (5) They are the first fruit unto God — Now the 144,000 Jews of (Rev. 7:3) are servants of God. (Israel was always called the servant) The 144,000 of (Rev. 14) are first fruits unto God and seemly hold a higher position! While the Israelites serve before God, the 144,000 first fruits sit with Christ in His throne! (Rev. 3:21) Now the Lord did not tell me this but this group of (Rev. 14:1) could have been the ones who cried to the wise virgins to get ready when “they said Behold the Bridegroom cometh go ye out to meet Him!” (Matt. 25:3-6) The Wise Virgins were asleep too (Matt. 25:5) But the group that made the cry were not asleep — Amen! The 144,000 of Rev. 14:1) were called virgins also so there is a connection together in the Bride body, although having a different work! One thing that sat them aside they knew what the name of God was! Although they believed in the Father, Son and Holy Ghost they only had one name written across their forehead! They did not believe in 3 different Gods, only one Lord working three different ways! They were a special revelation group, they were associated with Thunder! Watch in (Rev. 6:1) there was one Thunder, in (Rev. 10:4) there was 7 Thunders, and in (Rev. 14:2) there was a great Thunder! So all the other Thunders make a Great Thunder! Amen! We see there is almost irrefutable proof that the 144,000 of (Rev. 7:4) are different than the group of (Rev. 14:1) which are called the first fruits of God! By giving my view points on this, I am not teaching a false doctrine, but this is my opinion and I feel a very heavy anointing confirming this. Also remember the group of (Rev. 14:1) are not all which is in the Bride, for there will be many more than this! Since writing this I know the secret so I will leave it just like it is. The Mystery Group of God!! Great Thunder! (Rev. 14:2)

BRIEF EXPLANATION OF SCROLLS #26-27— I don’t think it neecssary to sign your name on Scroll 27 although you can. One of the main things hidden I feel is the blank space also symbolizes those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life. No one knows who they are (but I believe it is being revealed in those who believe the scroll message! God is now gathering His people into a Group! The scroll message is exactly what was promised to come, and unless people are predestine they will not receive or believe the scrolls! (On Scroll 26,27) what I was trying to explain was, for the last 2 years I have been writing the mysterious scrolls God spoke about. This is to separate and prepare the Elect for the rapture! I know this is great and yet so humble and that many will miss it! This is sent to a special group upon the earth (God gave it in divine order, The Silence (Rev. 8:1) moving into the Thunders (Rev. 10:4) A covering for the Elect. (Isa. 60:1-2) the strong anointing on the scrolls have been saved and is now being released for our day as the Bride is sealed! And anyone knows there is a powerful anointing on the scrolls “and unto the church of Laodiceans write these things (Rev. 3:14) At the Silence we see the 7 Trumpets prepare for the Tribulation (Kev. 8:1-2) Then the 7th Trumpet starts the Great Day of the Lord and 7 Vials are poured out (Rev. 11:15) (Rev. 16:1) Due to lack of space we had to cut short and omit several prophecies (That will be written later)
“TI Neal, a servant of the Lord Jesus Christ bless you all.”
